title: Dock cancel and drag dispatch live in the app, not the generic dock
evidence: EditorApplication::StepDock drains UIRenderNode::DrainCancelRequested and PanelDockHost::StepDrag, then dispatches ClosePanel/FloatPanel/ResizeRegion; the game app has no runtime for those verbs
expected: one generic panel-verb dispatch seam shared by every app hosting the dock

title: Escape needs two presses when a field inside the open dismissible panel has focus
evidence: R872.9 precedence rule (field revert first); witness run2 needed 1 Escape only because the header drag/clicks had blurred the filter field
expected: owner decision whether a flyout's autofocus field should let the first Escape dismiss

title: Splitter and header drag hit-testing is geometric (PanelDockDrag), not Rml elements
evidence: splitters have no element, so no hover cursor feedback and no readback selector
expected: decide if splitters become dock-chrome elements bound to the PanelLayout View

title: Full-tree build in a lane starved the laptop queue for 2.5 h
evidence: build-tests.sh built every target of build/wsl-debug (813), ~20 test links at once; stopped by controller at 782/813
expected: lane build scripts name explicit targets
